name: The University of Queensland
description: The University of Queensland is a public research university in Brisbane, founded in 1909, and a member of the Group of Eight. Its main campus is at St Lucia.
whyIncluded: The University of Queensland is among the 10 universities in Australia most chosen by international students (8,050 new overseas student commencements allocated for 2026 by the Australian Department of Education), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: UQ's own monthly budget for a student living off campus in Brisbane (rent, utilities, food, phone and transport, middle of its ranges) plus books.
livingCosts.notes: UQ 'Cost of living' page (no year given; 2026 is the year it was read), 'Off-campus/student accommodation' column of its monthly budget table, range midpoints: rent $736-$2,946 (1,841) + utilities $282-$350 (316) = housing 2,157; food $268-$606 (437); public transport 'from $23' (23); phone/internet $15-$150 (82.5) + books/supplies 'around $1,212 on average per year' (101) = personal 183.5. UQ's own column total is $1,326-$3,739 a month. On-campus colleges: $2,784-$4,327 a month (rent includes food and utilities). OSHC excluded.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.summary: Approximate 2027 yearly tuition for international students (16 units, a full-time year). Excludes the student services fee and health cover; UQ reviews fees each year.
programmes.notes: UQ program 2455, international fee on the program page read on 2026-10-07 ('Approximate yearly cost of tuition (16 units)'). History from UQ's official 'Domestic and International Full Tuition Fees' schedules (my.uq.edu.au fee schedules), which give the international rate per unit charged in that year by commencement cohort; the column for students commencing in that year was used and multiplied by 16 units, the full-time yearly load UQ's own program pages use. 2024: $3,200 per unit x 16 = A$51,200; 2025: $3,360 per unit x 16 = A$53,760; 2026: $3,628.50 per unit x 16 = A$58,056. St Lucia campus. Excludes SSAF and OSHC.
